title: REAR GUARD
subtitle: WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR. OFFICE SCALE. GLUTES ON. HINGE CLEAN. OWN THE WOBBLE.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. WEDNESDAY. REAR GUARD. FIFTEEN MINUTES. POSTERIOR CHAIN. WE WAKE THE GLUTES. WE HINGE CLEAN. NO HIDING BEHIND THAT CHAIR, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. REAR GUARD DONE. GLUTES WORKED. BACK HONEST. SEE YOU TOMORROW.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: FLAT ON YOUR BACK. FEET UNDER KNEES. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. RIBS DOWN. NO OVERARCHING.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGE. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. HEELS DOWN. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. RIBS QUIET. THIS IS THE REAR GUARD. WAKE THOSE GLUTES UP, YOU DESK JOCKEY.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. KEEP THE HIPS LOOSE. DO NOT SCROLL.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR FOR BALANCE. OWN THE WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH LEG. CONTROL THE DROP. CHAIR FOR BALANCE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT TIP OVER LIKE A DRUNK ON PARADE.

exercises.name: STANDING SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: ARMS FORWARD, PINCH SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR POSTURE DRILL. SLOW AND CLEAN.
exercises.speakStart: STANDING SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PINCH THE BLADES BACK AND DOWN. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR POSTURE DRILL. FIX THE DESK HUNCH. NO SHRUGS, YOU SLOPPY BUGGER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS QUIET.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS
exercises.cue: STAIR OR STURDY STEP. DRIVE THROUGH THE WHOLE FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. LIGHT HAND ON A WALL IF YOU WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP. STAND TALL. WALL FOR BALANCE IF YOU NEED IT. DRIVE THE GLUTE. OWN THE WOBBLE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. STEADY THE BREATH. STAY OFF THE RAILING FOR A NAP.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: LOW BACK FLAT ON THE FLOOR. SLOW OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. RIBS DOWN. POSTURE AND CORE. NO RUSH.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUG. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. BACK FLAT. SLOW. RIBS DOWN. CORE QUIET. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A WET NOODLE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE BACK QUIET.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUG COMPLETE. THAT IS THE LOT.
